title: crumb: how does a running state-mode session autosave storage state to the vault?
scope: Timer-driven saves in supervise(): snapshot cookies, localStorage and IndexedDB, merge with the vault entry, rewrite it.
omissions: Launch/handshake, signal-driven saves (crumb sync, crumb close)
Profile mode (same timer, persistent profile), agent CDP, login/check

groups.label: Local machine
groups.description: Local host; all three as one OS user

nodes.label: Chrome
nodes.description: Owned child, temp profile; close skips save

notes.title: Timer, skip, retry
notes.text: Default 30s; --autosave 0 = no timer. Ticks join an in-flight save; unchanged snapshot skips. Errors only go to run/<id>.log; before advances on success, so next tick retries.

notes.title: Merge in memory, no lock
notes.text: Step 4: cookies and localStorage merge per key (before→after diff) onto the fresh read; IndexedDB is copied whole per snapshot origin. No lock: writes in the 3→5 window are lost.

notes.title: Key cached; partly plaintext
notes.text: Key cached at startup (CRUMB_KEY or config.json keyStore); missing key fails launch. Only entry bodies are AES-256-GCM; header and run/ handle (lastSavedAt) are plaintext.
